The '''armor-piercing missile''', also known as '''AP missile''', was a type of weapon used by the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] during the [[Separatist War]]. Two of these missiles were used by the Separatists to put down a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Manka-class armored transport|APC]] in [[3643 BBY]], which was carrying a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|promising sergeant]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Bex Kolos|Gearbox]], killing several other soldiers and the driver onboard.
